parameter.name: ipAddress
parameter.label: Network Address
parameter.description: IP Network Address where air-Q Can Be Reached.

parameter.name: removeUnsupportedChannels
parameter.label: Remove Unsupported Channels
parameter.description: Removes the channels of measurements and settings that the device does not have. They are added again when the device reports them.

channel-group-type.label: Maximum Errors
channel-group-type.description: Worst-case error (±) of each measurement, in the unit of the measurement.

channel-type.label: Status of Sensors
channel-type.description: OK, or a message for each sensor without reliable data, e.g. during the warm-up phase.

channel-type.label: Fine Dust Count 0.3 µm
channel-type.description: Number of particles larger than 0.3 µm per 100 ml of air.

channel-type.label: Fine Dust Count 10 µm

channel-type.label: Change of CO₂ Concentration
channel-type.description: Change of the CO₂ concentration in ppb/s; 0 during the first 200 seconds.

channel-type.label: Change of Humidity
channel-type.description: Change of the absolute humidity in mg/m³/s.

channel-type.label: Door Event

channel-type.label: Health Index
channel-type.description: 0 to 100 % for a normal rating, -20 % during a gas alarm and -80 % during a fire alarm.

channel-type.label: Health Index Raw
channel-type.description: 0 to 1000 for a normal rating, -200 during a gas alarm and -800 during a fire alarm.

channel-type.label: Fire Alarm Active
channel-type.description: ON while the device raises a fire alarm, UNDEF while the fire alarm is disabled.

channel-type.label: Gas Alarm Active
channel-type.description: ON while the device raises a gas alarm, UNDEF while the gas alarm is disabled.

channel-type.label: Absolute Humidity
channel-type.description: Mass of water vapour per volume of air.

channel-type.label: Time Needed for Measurement
channel-type.description: Duration of one measurement cycle; grows with the number of sensors.

channel-type.label: Performance Index
channel-type.description: 0 to 100 % for a normal rating.

channel-type.label: Performance Index Raw
channel-type.description: 0 to 1000 for a normal rating.

channel-type.label: Health Index Raw
channel-type.description: 0 to 1000 for a normal rating, -200 during a gas alarm and -800 during a fire alarm.

channel-type.label: Performance Index Raw
channel-type.description: 0 to 1000 for a normal rating.

channel-type.label: Fine Dust 1 µm

channel-type.label: Fine Dust 2.5 µm

channel-type.label: Barometric Pressure
channel-type.description: Absolute air pressure at the location of the device.

channel-type.label: Noise
channel-type.description: A-weighted sound level, averaged.

channel-type.label: Time Stamp
channel-type.description: Time of the last measurement.

channel-type.label: Virus-Free Index
channel-type.description: Aerosol load with CO₂ as indicator; 100 % is fine, 0 % means insufficient ventilation.

channel-type.label: Mold-Free Index
channel-type.description: Mold risk from the long-term humidity; 100 % is fine, 0 % means insufficient ventilation.

channel-type.label: Industrial VOC
channel-type.description: VOC measured with the ION Science PID sensor.

channel-type.label: Relative Barometric Pressure
channel-type.description: Air pressure reduced to sea level (QNH); requires the altitude setting.

channel-type.label: Maximum Noise
channel-type.description: Maximum noise in the data rate interval; shows short loud events that averaging hides.

channel-type.description: Experimental, may not be reliable; requires advanced data processing.

channel-type.label: Wi-Fi Signal Strength
channel-type.description: Signal strength of the Wi-Fi connection, UNDEF while not connected.

channel-type.label: Air Flow 1

channel-type.description: In standard litres per minute at 20 °C and 1013 hPa.

channel-type.label: Air Flow 4
channel-type.description: In standard litres per minute at 20 °C and 1013 hPa.

Max. Error Virus-Free
channel-type.description: Maximum tolerated error in the Virus-Free Index measurement.

channel-type.label: Use WLAN
channel-type.description: Read-only, so the device cannot be taken off the network.

channel-type.label: Configured WLAN Networks
channel-type.description: Networks the device connects to; add networks with the setWifi action.

channel-type.label: Time Server
channel-type.description: NTP server the device synchronises its clock with every six hours.

channel-type.label: Start of Day Operation
channel-type.description: Minutes since midnight UTC at which day operation starts.

channel-type.label: End of Day Operation
channel-type.description: Minutes since midnight UTC at which night operation starts.

channel-type.label: Day Brightness of LED
channel-type.description: 0 (off) to 10.

channel-type.label: Night Brightness of LED
channel-type.description: 0 (off) to 10.

channel-type.label: Switch Off WLAN at Night
channel-type.description: The device cannot be reached at night; the cloud upload is buffered until the morning.

channel-type.label: Night Mode
channel-type.description: Whether the night mode is used; the other night mode settings are kept while it is off.

channel-type.label: Switch Off Acoustic Signals at Night
channel-type.description: Suppresses the acoustic signals at night; fire and gas alarms are still given.

channel-type.label: Day Operation
channel-type.description: ON while the device is in day operation, OFF while it is in night operation.

channel-type.label: Room Type
channel-type.description: Helps the device recognise situations typical for the room.

channel-type.label: Logging Level
channel-type.description: Detail of the device log on the SD card: Error, Warning or Info.

channel-type.label: Fire Alarm Enabled
channel-type.description: Alarm for CO above 200 mg/m³, PM1 above 400 µg/m³ or a temperature above 70 °C.

channel-type.label: Network BSSID
channel-type.description: MAC address of the access point the device is connected to.

channel-type.label: Data Rate
channel-type.description: Interval at which the current average is stored and uploaded to the cloud.

channel-type.label: Power Frequency
channel-type.description: Mains frequency filter for noise and gas sensors: 50Hz, 60Hz or 50Hz+60Hz.

channel-type.label: Compensate Automatic Drift
channel-type.description: Compensates the slow drift of the sensors over time and from high humidity.

channel-type.label: Automatic Firmware Update Interval
channel-type.description: Days between automatic firmware updates, 0 = off (default 90); an update restarts it.

channel-type.label: Advanced Data Processing
channel-type.description: Enables the detection of events such as open windows or persons.

channel-type.label: Gases in ppm and ppb
channel-type.description: Deprecated: CO in ppm, NO₂, O₃ and SO₂ in ppb, unless units are configured on the device.

channel-type.label: Gas Alarm Enabled
channel-type.description: Alarm for concentrations hazardous to health, e.g. O₂ below 13 % or NO₂ above 20 mg/m³.

channel-type.label: Sound Info
channel-type.description: Acoustic signals for thresholds, with frequency, volume, duration and repetition.

channel-type.label: Share Alarms With Other air-Q
channel-type.description: Forwards fire and gas alarms to the other air-Q devices in the household.

channel-type.label: Last Sensor Calibration
channel-type.description: Last user calibration of each sensor, as "sensor: offset=value [dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss]".

channel-type.label: Averaging Window
channel-type.description: Number of measurements the device averages over; 1 disables averaging (default 30).

channel-type.label: Warm-up Phase
channel-type.description: ON while the gas and VOC sensors warm up, up to 60 minutes after power-on; OFF ends it.

channel-type.label: Last Summer/Winter Time Switch
channel-type.description: Not documented by the manufacturer.

channel-type.label: Cloud Connection
channel-type.description: State of the connection to the air-Q Cloud, e.g. DISCONNECTED.

channel-type.label: Boot Counters
channel-type.description: Not documented by the manufacturer.

channel-type.label: Altitude
channel-type.description: Height above sea level for the relative pressure, UNDEF if not set; needs a restart.

channel-type.label: Altitude Error
channel-type.description: Estimated error of the altitude.

channel-type.label: Building Standard
channel-type.description: VOC evaluation according to a building standard: None, WELL or RESET.

channel-type.label: Country
channel-type.description: Time zone for the summer/winter time switch in night mode, and the cloud endpoint.

channel-type.label: Room Height
channel-type.description: Used by the advanced data processing, 0 if not set.

channel-type.label: Room Area
channel-type.description: Used by the advanced data processing, 0 if not set.

channel-type.label: Max. Error Virus-Free
channel-type.description: Maximum tolerated error in the Virus-Free Index measurement.

channel-type.label: Max. Error Mold-Free
channel-type.description: Maximum tolerated error in the Mold-Free Index measurement.

channel-type.label: Start of Day Operation
channel-type.description: Time in HH:mm UTC at which day operation starts.

channel-type.label: End of Day Operation
channel-type.description: Time in HH:mm UTC at which night operation starts.

channel-type.label: Values in Particles
channel-type.description: Deprecated: reports CO in ppm and NO₂, O₃ and SO₂ in ppb. The device ignores it for sensors with a unit set in its units setting.
